halo.$description: Dark-mode halo shades, chosen so the halo keeps the soft contrast it has in light mode. The light *.200 halos sit at 1.28-1.42:1 against white; against the dark base surface (gray.900) they would reach 11.7-13:1. Each value is the family's shade closest to the light-mode ratio against gray.900: blue-sky.800 1.44, red.900 1.69, apricot.900 1.75, green.900 1.72. The halo is decorative; the 3px outer ring is the focus indicator.
